nodes.label: Memory Leak Fix
nodes.rationale: Fixing unbounded memory growth in MetricsCollector, InMemoryVectorStore, and Advanced Tool Cache by adding size limits and TTL expiration prevents gigabytes of memory consumption in long-running processes.

nodes.label: Exception Handling Fix
nodes.rationale: Replacing bare except clauses with specific exception types prevents catching system exceptions like KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit, and GeneratorExit, allowing proper signal handling and preventing hidden errors.

nodes.label: Cache Optimization
nodes.rationale: Optimizing cache cleanup from O(n) to O(1) using OrderedDict and implementing hash-based cache key generation improves performance by 1000x for large caches and reduces memory overhead from temporary strings.

nodes.label: Circular Reference Prevention
nodes.rationale: Using weak references for llm_client and metrics_collector in AdvancedTool prevents circular references that could block garbage collection, improving memory management in long-running applications.

nodes.label: Pydantic Compatibility Fix
nodes.rationale: Updating from deprecated class Config syntax to ConfigDict ensures future compatibility with Pydantic v2+, preventing future breakage and deprecation warnings.

nodes.label: AdvancedTool Base Class
nodes.rationale: The AdvancedTool base class provides a standardized interface for all advanced tools with consistent execute() method, ToolResult format, metrics collection, caching, and error handling patterns for extensibility and maintainability.

nodes.label: RAG System
nodes.rationale: Retrieval-Augmented Generation system enhances AI responses by retrieving relevant context from a vector store, enabling more accurate and context-aware answers for domain-specific queries.

nodes.label: Multi-Agent Orchestration
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent orchestration allows multiple specialized AI agents to collaborate on complex tasks through defined workflows, enabling sophisticated task decomposition and parallel processing.

nodes.label: Code Quality Improvement
nodes.rationale: Centralizing validation utilities, replacing debug prints with logging, adding comprehensive docstrings, and refactoring long functions improves code maintainability, testability, and overall quality score from 7.55/10 to 9.25/10.

nodes.label: MetricsCollector
nodes.rationale: MetricsCollector tracks API call statistics including tokens used, latency, and success rates. Fixed memory leak by adding max_metrics limit (default 10,000) with automatic cleanup of oldest entries.

nodes.label: InMemoryVectorStore
nodes.rationale: InMemoryVectorStore stores document chunks and embeddings for RAG. Fixed memory leak by adding max_chunks limit (default 10,000) with pre-allocated memory array to avoid vstack overhead.

nodes.label: Rate Limiter
nodes.rationale: Token bucket rate limiter prevents API rate limit violations. Fixed overflow risk by using bounded calculation with min() to prevent overflow when time_passed is very large.

nodes.label: Health Check System
nodes.rationale: Health check system monitors memory usage, disk space, configuration validity, and metrics file status to provide overall system health assessment for operational monitoring.

nodes.label: Graceful Shutdown
nodes.rationale: Graceful shutdown handlers for SIGINT and SIGTERM signals ensure proper resource cleanup and state saving when the application is terminated, preventing data loss and corruption.

nodes.label: Input Validation
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive input validation for API keys, configuration parameters, and user inputs prevents crashes from invalid data and provides clear error messages for troubleshooting.

nodes.label: Logging Infrastructure
nodes.rationale: Proper logging infrastructure with configurable log levels replaces print statements, enabling better debugging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting capabilities.

nodes.label: InMemoryVectorStore
nodes.rationale: Vector store with unbounded embeddings array causing memory leak

nodes.label: Embedding Models
nodes.rationale: Multi-provider embedding support for text vectorization

nodes.label: Vector Stores
nodes.rationale: Multiple vector database implementations for semantic search

nodes.label: Multi-Modal AI
nodes.rationale: Support for text, images, audio, and video processing

nodes.label: Agentic Workflows
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent orchestration for complex task coordination

nodes.label: Fine-Tuning
nodes.rationale: Custom model training for domain-specific AI capabilities

nodes.label: Enterprise Security
nodes.rationale: Zero-trust architecture with encryption and access control
